set.body:
The load-bearing change. Replace list()+modifyList configuration with ordinary
constructor functions whose formals are the schema:

  noise_spec(struct, p, q, iter_gls, pooling, parcels, voxelwise, exact_first, censor)
  robust_spec(type, k_huber, c_tukey, max_iter, scale_scope)
  variance_spec(method, max_lag, taper, debias, df)
  weights_spec(...); projection_spec(...)
  compute_spec(strategy, nchunks, fast_path, parallel, progress)

Gains, none of which need validation code written:
  - noise_spec(typo_key=99) errors with R's own "unused argument"
  - ?noise_spec, autocompletion, partial matching
  - printable, comparable, round-trippable objects

Naming decisions:
  - pooling= replaces global= (a logical encoding one of three states) and matches
    fmriAR's vocabulary
  - ar_options$by_cluster folds into pooling="parcel" + parcels=; it is currently a
    live option read at R/aaa_plugin_api.R:210,234,241,277 that appears in no
    default list and no documentation
  - robust_spec(type="none") replaces the triple-typed robust argument

Additive - nothing else changes in this bead.
set.title: Add *_spec() constructors: noise, robust, variance, weights, projection, compute
